# Yoshi Sushi

> Sushi Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. A small, cozy neighborhood spot where reviewers call the sushi fresh, the staff friendly and the room the closest thing to an izakaya in Tampa.

- Phone: (813) 792-7515
- Address: 7895 Gunn Hwy, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Carrollwood, Temple Terrace, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Sushi on the boat; Dinner boxes; Stir fry plates
- Rating: 4.7 from 511 Google reviews
